svg.aria-label: Core2350B component-side physical P4 and P3 header locator
svg.title: Core2350B component-side physical P4 and P3 header locator
svg.text: RP2350B package, A2 silicon · 8 MB PSRAM / 16 MB flash · component side · USB FPC TOP
Bus-test build: 6.3MHz GPU; black HDMI only; electrical timing unqualified
RP2350 A2; one 100Ω per signal wire; two 4.7kΩ handshake pull-downs fitted
Use the Core2350B connector labels below; Pico 2 header numbering does not apply.
WREADY · Tang J6.1 · Core LED load
P4 contacts read TOP → BOTTOM. Outer column is toward the board's right edge.
GP39: WREADY input only; red LED + 470Ω to GND loads the Tang output. Disable RP LED writes.
Read both rows LEFT → RIGHT. Inner / even row is nearer the board centre.
Component side, USB FPC toward top:
P1 left · P2 top · P3 bottom · P4 right.
Signals use P3/P4. Bond P1.1 GND to Tang J5.2 as well.
Keep ALL 16 signal links OPEN until compatible Core firmware
+ FPGA image are installed; old powered images need links open.
One 100Ω per signal wire; end unknown. R does not make contention safe.
Connector locator only. P3/P4 drawings are expanded for legibility and are not a scale board drawing. Do not mirror for solder side.
Sources: user wiring revision, Core2350B schematic and component-side photograph; provenance in the pinout JSON.
